steps.message:
Added to `index.html:9`:

```html
<main>
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox"> Done
  </label>
</main>
```

A native `<input type="checkbox">` wrapped in a `<label>`, so the text is a click target and it's accessible without extra attributes. On/off state is the browser's own — no JS needed.

No tests run; the repo has no test setup or build. Two things you'll likely want next, but I left them out since you asked for just the control: the state isn't persisted across reloads, and there's one checkbox rather than one per task item (the page has no task list yet).
